purpose: Retry native ODA peer conversion after the user unlocked the macOS session, using the exact existing AC1021 source that contains the selected inline-SAB torus graph.

selectedEntity.interpretation: Both peer exports retain the selected entity and its history handle. The payload is opaque proprietary modeler data in these outputs; it is not decoded as SAT/SAB and is not compared field-by-field with source SAB.

result: The unlocked native converter route now starts and completes both exports. This resolves the local desktop-access/CLI initialization blocker and provides an ODA-produced carrier for the selected graph, but does not resolve the independent semantic/kernel evidence gate or qualify broad source/output support.
fixturePolicy: The source is an existing committed DWG in the separate dwg-writer repository. ODA DXFs and logs remain in /private/tmp; no drawing fixture was added to libdxfrw.
